program: Wingless RSI corrective tranche: bounded calibration interaction attribution
question: After R38 showed that simple 2-of-3 sign consensus covers most excluded cases but predicts held-out sign worse than the raw BASE6 model, is the residual failure caused by missing bounded interactions among the existing BASE6 internal conditions rather than by unstable labels alone?
hypothesis: R38 rejects simple transferable sign consensus: majority coverage was 29/33 but majority sign error was 0.6897 versus 0.4828 for RAW_BASE6 on the same covered subset. Freeze a bounded nonlinear attribution without changing data, budget, labels, or solver. BASE6_LINEAR is the byte-identical R38/R37 raw-target ridge model. BASE6_PAIRWISE appends exactly the 15 unique pairwise products x_i*x_j for the six frozen BASE6 features (i<j), with no squares, learned basis, feature selection, normalization tuning, or hidden capacity. Fit the same ridge lambda=1 on the same three training manifests per outer holdout and score only the exact 33 R30-excluded cases. This tests whether marginal learning value is a fixed low-order interaction of existing internal conditions.

predecessor.eliminated_hypothesis: a simple nonzero 2-of-3 training-manifest sign consensus provides a transferable allocation-value label on the excluded cases
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: marginal future learning value may depend on bounded interactions among existing internal conditions rather than a context-independent sign label

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R38's majority label covered 87.9% of excluded cases but increased held-out sign error by 20.69 points relative to the raw BASE6 predictor on the same covered subset.
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: append only the 15 deterministic pairwise products of the six frozen BASE6 features; keep targets, solver, ridge lambda, manifests, candidates, budget, exclusion, and held-out ordering unchanged
cause_effect_trace.control_rule: BASE6_LINEAR is byte-identical R38/R37 RAW_BASE6 raw-target predictor
cause_effect_trace.interaction_rule: BASE6_PAIRWISE = six BASE6 features plus x_i*x_j for every unique i<j pair; exactly 21 total features including intercept; no squares and no data-dependent feature construction
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: R39 is attribution only. Support authorizes only a separately preregistered bounded interaction-aware correction/replication; allocator behavior remains unchanged.

classification_rules.mixed: valid AND pairwise_sign_error_improvement>0 AND pairwise_mae_ratio<1.10 but one or both supported thresholds are missed
classification_rules.negative: valid AND supported is false AND mixed is false
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, manifest identity, 1744 budget, exact R30 exclusion, BASE6 identity, fixed 15-pair construction, raw target, ridge lambda, held-out ordering, deterministic replay, provenance or accounting requirement fails

rsi_success_note: R39 is interaction attribution on studied manifests; no allocator policy is changed and prospective disjoint validation remains required.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter manifests, BASE6, the 15 pair list, target, ridge lambda, thresholds, exclusion set, budget/capacity, held-out ordering, classification or authority after primary output.
